description.narrative: The ICT is an International Development organisation dedicated towards improving the lives of vulnerable children in developing countries. The ICT supports the development of the capacity of overseas partners in improving the lives of marginalized and vulnerable children that are unable to access their rights to education, health and a life free of violence and abuse. Partner target groups include children in child labour (including domestic work) or at risk thereof, and streetworking and living children. Our partners work with those children that are most vulnerable and have fallen through government safety nets and often are also out of reach of other NGO activities due to their challenging behaviour and/or circumstances.Consultations in the past have highlighted the need for a focus on fundraising, and while recommendations were followed up and some achievements have been made, the current economic crisis has produced new setbacks. It is clear that the organisation needs support to adapt its fundraising strategies to the current economic climate so it can continue to address the needs of our partners.
